title: Remote-bound console POST protection can be bypassed with local Host spoofing
description: Evidence: dashboard --host can bind non-local, served HTML includes the console token, validateConsoleOrigin accepts missing Origin, and Host validation always allows localhost/127.* even when configuredHost is 0.0.0.0. Impact: a network client can fetch the token and POST with a spoofed local Host header to run confirmed console mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-local console binds require an explicit unsafe/remote flag and stricter mutating-request checks.
A console-server regression proves token-fetch plus Host: localhost spoofing fails when the listener is bound to 0.0.0.0.
